What and why: 
An improved security key sign-in experience is available on Windows 11 devices with display-based Near Field Communication (NFC) readers. A new on-screen indicator now shows where to tap your security key during sign-in. The indicator adjusts to the device's screen orientation, making it easier to locate the NFC reader.
 
Rollout schedule:
This improved sign-in experience and simpler appearance are available starting with the November 2026 Windows non-security update.
 
Impact on your organization:
Devices with Near Field Communication (NFC) prioritize secure access and sign-in. Some NFC antennas are visually easy for users to detect while others aren't. Windows 11 devices with the antenna located on the front or edge of the display now include the tap location indicator on the lock screen for quick identification and security key sign-in.
 
Action required/recommendations:
See new IT guidance and the updated device maker guidance on how to configure this experience. As an admin, you have two options:
  • Use Microsoft Intune to create a custom policy with the Policy CSP - CredentialProviders.
  • Create or edit a Group Policy Object (GPO) with the setting EnableNFCTapLocationIndicator under the following path: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\System\Logon.
 
Compliance considerations:
This feature prioritizes secure access and sign-in. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Title: Configure security key sign-in experience for display-based NFC readers
